_source: Targets, threshold, window and payment parameters follow the ACCESS rules in references/attainment-rules.md (PHQ-9 5-point and GAD-7 4-point reduction if baseline 10 or more, else final under 10 (CMS Table 5 control target); all required measures per patient; missing counts as failure; lost patients stay in the denominator; end-of-period no later than day 425; 50 percent threshold; proportional payment with 50 percent cap; BH initial $180 allowed; the payment base is the $144 Medicare portion, of which $72 is withheld). Not modeled: PGIC end-of-period submission (no column in the illustrative data) and relocation or ineligibility exclusions (no unalignment reason in the data); both are open items. bh_rules_person_below10_dropped.json is the same file with the person's own rule (measure not required below baseline 10).
